metadata.hardware_requirements: NVIDIA Quadro K620 GPU and Intel Xeon CPU E5-1650 (3.6 GHz, 6 cores). Quote: "computing server with NVIDIA Quadro K620 GPU and Intel Xeon CPU E5-1650 (3.6 GHz, 6 cores)"

nodes_source.source_quote: The data used to support the results of this study are available from the corresponding author upon request.
nodes_source.description: Empirical traffic data, including video frames and traffic volumes (7:50 a.m. to 9:00 a.m.), collected from the freeway connecting Qingdao and Huangdao in Shandong, China.
nodes_source.reproducibility_rationale: The Data Availability statement explicitly notes that the data is available upon request from the corresponding author, with no public repository or link provided.

nodes_process.source_quote: The simulation parameters regarding driving behaviors are calibrated based on empirical data.
nodes_process.description: The SUMO microscopic traffic simulator is calibrated using real-world empirical traffic data to model the freeway connecting Qingdao and Huangdao. The simulation covers the mainline and on-ramp with specific speed limits.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=3, SUMO simulator named, key speed limits and simulation times stated.

nodes_process.source_quote: After zooming and down-sampling, the size of one observation is 4 × 512 in pixels. Three consecutive observations are stacked to represent the traffic state.
nodes_process.description: Vehicle locations are extracted from simulated video frames. The images are zoomed and down-sampled, and three consecutive frames are stacked to form the state matrix for the DRL agent.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, no specific image processing library named, but frame sizes and stack counts are explicitly stated.

nodes_process.source_quote: The gradient-based algorithm Adam [28] is used to update wi to minimize the loss function.
nodes_process.description: A Deep Q-Network with 3 CNN layers and 1 FC layer is trained using Deep Q-learning, experience replay, and a target network. The Adam optimizer minimizes a multitask loss function predicting Q-value, speed, and queue length.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, all hyperparameters stated in Table 1, but no specific deep learning framework (e.g., PyTorch/TensorFlow) is named.

nodes_process.source_quote: The Q-network is trained in 10^6 training frames, and each scenario is evaluated in 20 simulation experiments.
nodes_process.description: The trained DRL agent is evaluated against a no-control scenario and the PI-ALINEA baseline over 20 simulation experiments with different random seeds to compare travel times, speeds, and queue lengths.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, baseline named, all evaluation parameters and PI-ALINEA constants are explicitly stated.

nodes_process.source_quote: A perturbation analysis is conducted to evaluate the impact of information contained in video data. As shown in Figure 15, the control area is divided into eight subareas.
nodes_process.description: An ablation study is performed by dividing the control area into 8 subareas and removing information from different subareas to generate perturbed data, evaluating the impact on travel time.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=3, no specific tool named for perturbation, but subarea counts and experiment counts are stated.
